# How to Update Org-wide Custom Instructions

## Steps

1. **Edit [.github/custom-instructions.md](../custom-instructions.md) with your proposed changes.**
2. **Ensure all referenced files are current and reflect the latest standards.**
3. **Follow the frontmatter schema defined in [frontmatter.instructions.md](../frontmatter.instructions.md).**
4. **Open a PR for review and link to the relevant change(s) in [copilot.instructions.md](../copilot.instructions.md).**

---

Remember to update any related instructions indexes or documentation as appropriate.
